decision.observation: Clock frozen at 6:20 am for 5+ consecutive turns. Farmer holding Tortilla above head in the eat-confirm pose. Energy critically low (thin yellow sliver on E bar). The buttonless hover did NOT advance the clock, confirming focus is still lost. Only left-clicks with a button press have restored focus in this session.
decision.hypothesis: In Stardew Valley, the hold-up animation is the eat-confirm prompt, and a left-click anywhere — including on the farmer sprite itself — should both restore focus AND confirm eating the food in one action. Left-clicking the farmer directly at ~x0.53,y0.52 is worth trying instead of clicking open floor.
decision.memory: Hover alone does NOT restore focus — only left-click with button does. Left-clicking open floor while food is selected may swing a tool and cancel the eat animation. Try left-clicking the farmer sprite directly to both restore focus and confirm eating. If that fails, open inventory with E and right-click the Tortilla inside to get an Eat menu option — more reliable than the toolbar eat pose.
